definitions.gloss: 7th day memorial service; first seventh-day service
definitions.explanation: A Buddhist memorial service held on the seventh day after a person's death. The first of several memorial services marking the deceased's journey in the afterlife.

examples.japanese: {初七日|しょなのか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We held the seventh-day memorial service.

examples.japanese: {初七日|しょなのか}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{魂|たましい}→魂：14639_tamashii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is said the soul remains in this world until the seventh day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{初七日|しょなのか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Recently, it's common to hold the funeral and seventh-day service on the same day.

notes:
In Japanese Buddhism, the soul undergoes judgment every seven days for 49 days.

MEMORIAL SERVICE SEQUENCE:
- {初七日|しょなのか}: 7th day
- ⟦{二七日|ふたなのか}→二七日：noentry⟧: 14th day
- ⟦{三七日|みなのか}→三七日：noentry⟧: 21st day
- ⟦{四七日|よなのか}→四七日：noentry⟧: 28th day
- ⟦{五七日|いつなのか}→五七日：noentry⟧: 35th day
- ⟦{六七日|むなのか}→六七日：noentry⟧: 42nd day
- ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧: 49th day (most important)

MODERN PRACTICE:
Many families now combine {初七日|しょなのか} with the ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧ service for convenience.
